notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.
